title: 장애예술인 문화예술 활동 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism ( Arts Policy Division ), 044-203-2773

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「장애예술인 문화예술 활동 지원에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(문화시설 개선비용의 지원 절차) ① 「장애예술인 문화예술 활동 지원에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제12조제2항 및 같은 법 시행령(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제6조제2항에 따른 장애예술인의 문화시설 접근성 개선에 필요한 비용(이하 “문화시설 개선비용”이라 한다)을 지원받으려는 자는 영 제6조제2항에 따라 별지 제1호서식의 지원신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 문화체육관광부장관이나 지방자치단체의 장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Procedure for Support of Cultural Facility Improvement Costs) ①Any person who wishes to receive supportaccessibility to cultural facilities for artists with disabilities pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 2 of the Act on Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Article 6 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism or the head of a local government, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs to the support application form in Annex No. 1 pursuant toof the Decree.
1. Current Status of Cultural Facilities Targeted for Improvement

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 지원신청서를 받은 문화체육관광부장관이나 지방자치단체의 장은 개선계획서 및 예산서의 타당성 등을 고려하여 문화시설 개선비용 지원 여부를 결정하고, 그 결과를 신청인에게 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism or the head of a local government who receives an application for support pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall decide whether to provide support for the improvement of cultural facilities by considering the validity of the improvement plan and budget statement, and notify the applicant of the result.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(전담기관의 지정 절차) ① 법 제14조제1항에 따른 전담기관으로 지정받으려는 기관은 영 제7조제2항에 따라 별지 제2호서식의 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 문화체육관광부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Procedure for Designation of Dedicated Agency) ①An agency seeking designation as a dedicated agency pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, in accordance with Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, an application for designation in Form No. 2 of the Appendix, with the following documents attached.

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제7조제1항 각 호의 요건을 갖추었음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving that the requirements of each subparagraph of Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree have been met

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 지정신청서를 받은 문화체육관광부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통해 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism who receives the application for designation under Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 문화체육관광부장관이 영 제7조제3항에 따라 발급해야 하는 전담기관 지정서는 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The designation certificate for a specialized agency that the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism must issue pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Annex 3 .
ADDENDA <Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism Decree No. 422, Dec. 14, 2020>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
[Attachment Form No. 1] Application for Support for Cultural Facility Improvement Costs
